said.title: Fall Term 2027 Begins
said.text: Tuition, $21,031.08 a term, is covered by the tuition scholarship. Yale’s aid for living costs goes by need, and your family’s means rule it out, so this term’s Yale Health plan, $2,034.44, was paid from your bank, and living costs are yours.
